project.title: Airborne bacteria Metagenome Darjeeling
project.description: Airborne samples are collected from the hilltop region of the Eastern Himalayas to study its diversity and pathogenicity. Effects of meteorological parameters and different types of atmspheric transport processes are studied on the alteration of airborne bacterial communities.
